method.balance_policy: multi-row components first by affected-category balance; remaining singletons go to the category's least-populated fold; seeded hashes break exact ties
method.duplicate_policy: all rows in a duplicate component share one fold
method.small_category_policy: populate min(5, atomic_component_count) distinct folds; folds that cannot be populated remain empty

purpose: same-category diagnostic only; never replaces category-disjoint primary result
